notes.title: New game out now: Lust Survivor
notes.content:
Hello! After a couple years of hard work our third game, Lust Survivor is out for you to enjoy. Lust Survivor follows 7 girls that are stranded alone on an uninhabited planet, you'll have to decide for the group who gets along with who and what they decide to do about their situation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339730/Lust_Survivor/

This game has similar content to Lust Vessel, there is plenty of girl- girl and futa - girl but we didn't forget about monster - girl in the bad endings. Aside from that this game has cameos from Kate and Erica outside of the main story. 

I would add more images, but you maybe someone else is in the room, you know what to expect! Sexy girls in a forest.

notes.title: Release day
notes.content:
Sorry for all the delay, but Lust Vessel is finally here! We spent countless hours in this game and worked on it almost until now,  but after years of hard work (about 2.5) our game is ready for you to play and we hope you like it. 
Remember to lose battles so you can enjoy the game at it's fullest!
